feat(tools): activity tiers, presentation score, make meta

- lib/activity.mjs: active/dormant tiers from human project commits in the
  last 90 days (bots and manifest-only sweeps excluded; TIER_OVERRIDES pin)
- lib/presentation.mjs: README/docs/GitHub-side checks for active repos,
  blessable via `presentation:<key>` in .consistency-ignore
- github-meta.mjs (`make meta`): cache description, topics, homepage,
  protection, per-workflow CI and latest release in .github-meta.json
- dashboard: Active/Dormant sections, Presentation column and cards
- make changes: tracks tier moves and presentation regressions/fixes
- make report: refreshes meta; CI section lists every failing workflow
- manifest: .github/CODEOWNERS baseline from tools/templates/CODEOWNERS
- lib/github.mjs: shared token resolution and API client

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
